name: thunar-fill-location
narration: An agent types into a real text field by semantic identity — and we read it back to prove it landed.
notes: VALIDATED end-to-end on the live Lun.Os XFCE container (2026-08-26). Targets Thunar's editable location entry (role Text) via native AT-SPI EditableText (path=NativeAction) — no /dev/uinput. Demonstrates the demo-1 'fill this out' capability.

steps.say: Typing a new path — through the accessibility tree, not the keyboard
Verifying by reading the field back
